title: 28,800 Bath Toys Fell In The Ocean. Scientists Tracked Them 🦆
caption:
Twenty eight thousand bath toys fell into the ocean 🦆
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1992 a container of bath toys (ducks, beavers, turtles and frogs) fell off a cargo ship crossing the Pacific. Oceanographers tracked where the toys washed up to learn about ocean currents. The first ones reached Alaska around ten months later.
Which toy would you have followed? 👇
first_comment: Ducks, beavers, turtles or frogs. Which one would you bet on to reach land first? 🦆🐸👇
